import tarfile
import os

def extract_wish_files(tar_file):
    tar = tarfile.open(tar_file)
    extract_dir = '/tmp/wishes'
    tar.extractall(extract_dir + '/../')
    tar.close()

extract_wish_files('wishes.tar')
